EncryptedCloudVault.title: Encrypted Cloud Vault
EncryptedCloudVault.description: Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encrypted authenticator vault and Argon2id-wrapped 256-bit vault key owned by a single authenticated user. No plaintext TOTP secrets or recovery passwords are ever stored.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the vault owner (immutable).

vaultUuid.description: Unique identifier for the vault encryption lineage used to detect cross-device conflicts.

vaultVersion.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter for safe synchronization and conflict detection.

accountCount.description: Number of authenticator accounts encrypted inside the vault payload.

deviceName.description: Non-sensitive label of the Android device that performed the last backup.

kdfAlgorithm.description: Key derivation algorithm used to derive the key-wrapping key from the user recovery password.

kdfSalt.description: Base64-encoded unique cryptographic salt for Argon2id.

kdfMemoryKb.description: Argon2id memory cost parameter in KiB.

wrappedVaultKey.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the random 256-bit vault key wrapped with the Argon2id-derived key.

wrappedVaultKeyIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte GCM initialization vector used to wrap the vault key.

encryptedVault.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the serialized authenticator accounts.

encryptedVaultIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte GCM initialization vector used to encrypt the vault payload.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial vault backup creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent encrypted backup update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/vaults/{vaultId}.description: Per-user zero-knowledge encrypted authenticator vault storage (primary vault document at vaultId = 'primary').
